WHAT TO EXPECT

Tire changes

Square State Towing provides tire-change assistance. When calling, mention which tire is affected, whether a usable spare is available, and whether the vehicle has locking wheel nuts. Confirm that roadside access allows the work to be carried out.

Have these details ready

  • Which tire is affected and the vehicle model
  • Whether you have a usable spare tire
  • Availability of the wheel-lock key, if fitted

Before you confirm

Ask about vehicle suitability, current availability, the estimated arrival time, and the total cost. Any extra work or destination changes should be discussed with the operator.

What if there is no usable spare?+

Explain this when you call. Ask whether an alternative service or a tow is needed; do not assume a replacement tire is supplied.
